notes: Budgets are broad CI guardrails, not marketing benchmark claims.
Thresholds should be tightened only after collecting repeatable machine-class data.

serializeLargeDocument.description: Serialize the parsed large fixture without rewriting source.

richMountLargeDocument.description: Build a ProseMirror rich state from the large fixture.

richSerializeLargeDocument.description: Serialize the large rich state back to Markdown.

renderHtmlLargeDocument.description: Render and sanitize the large fixture to HTML.

outlineLargeDocument.description: Build an editor session and derive the large fixture outline.

findReplaceLargeDocument.description: Find and replace one heading in the large fixture through the headless session.

saveHashLargeDocument.description: Hash the large fixture through the shared save/core hash.

saveAutosaveTruth.description: Update large content, check autosave debounce truth, and flush to a memory target.

docsPublicRender.description: Render declared public Markdown docs through @momentarise/md-render-html.
